Game Overview

At its heart, Variety Mecha is a shooter game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of Variety Mecha follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Variety Mecha?

Variety Mecha is a free shooter game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Variety Mecha free to play?

Yes, Variety Mecha is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
